name: Gästehaus Auer
beschreibung:
Surrounded by the scenic landscapes of the Thiersee valley, Gaestehaus Auer provides comfortable rooms and holiday apartments. Its sunny location offers an ideal retreat between lake shores and peaks.

Lake Thiersee, scenic hiking paths around Mount Pendling, and the town of Kufstein are conveniently close.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Auer in Thiersee impresses with friendly hospitality and countryside relaxation in Kufsteinerland.
